map.输入最大频偏 Δf 与调制频率 fm，求调频指数。: Enter maximum frequency deviation Delta f and modulation frequency fm to find the FM modulation index.
map.📚 深度解析：FM 调制指数 β: Deep dive: FM modulation index beta
map.调频指数 β = 最大频偏/调制频率。: FM modulation index beta = maximum deviation / modulation frequency.
map.判断窄带/宽带 FM 与边带数目。: Determine narrowband/wideband FM and the number of sidebands.
map.卡森带宽公式的输入。: Input for the Carson bandwidth formula.
map.调制指数 β = 75 / 15 = 5，属宽带 FM，边带较多。: Modulation index beta = 75 / 15 = 5, wideband FM with many sidebands.
map.若 Δf=5kHz、fm=15kHz，则 β≈0.33，接近窄带 FM（β≪1）: If Delta f=5kHz, fm=15kHz, then beta~0.33, close to narrowband FM (beta << 1).
map.β 与带宽关系？: What is the relation between beta and bandwidth?
map.卡森带宽 ≈ 2(Δf + fm) = 2fm(β+1)，β 越大占用频带越宽。: Carson bandwidth ~ 2(Delta f + fm) = 2fm(beta+1); a larger beta occupies a wider band.
map.宽带与窄带如何界定？: How are wideband and narrowband defined?
map.通常 β≪1 为窄带 FM，β 较大为宽带 FM，无绝对硬界。: Usually beta << 1 is narrowband FM and a larger beta is wideband FM; there is no absolute hard boundary.

Criteria: no fixed grading; β < 1 narrowband FM, β > 1 wideband FM, the Carson bandwidth ≈ 2×(Δf+f_m), and the larger β the wider the occupied spectrum.
